method.source: Read actual committed editorial_clock.py and model.py through the GitHub read connector; execute their source in temporary in-memory Python modules.
method.drawing_dependency: Provide the same clamp-to-[0,1] smoothstep expression v*v*(3-2*v) as drawing.smooth; no image compositor or encoding is run.
method.frozen_inputs: Read local received copies of data/cyb_daily.csv and editorial/2015/releases/v1.0.1/director_timeline.json; independently recompute both SHA-256 digests.
runs: EditorialClock(..., width=540, photo_available=False): inspect all states, all cue joins, primary-anchor coordinates after each hit, and selected stage values.
EditorialClock(..., width=540, photo_available=True): inspect camera_adjustments and projections at frames 3630, 3645, 3780 and 3810; no photograph file was loaded or drawn.
method.primary_anchor_visibility: For each frame at or after that cue's hit, project its fixed date/value through that frame's camera and check 26 <= x <= 704 and 252 <= y <= 846. This checks anchor coordinates, not rasterized marker visibility or occlusion.

zoom_at_32_seconds.interpretation: One-second horizontal zoom approximately 6.94x and vertical zoom approximately 3.00x; this is whole-chart camera motion, not per-candle OHLC alteration.

code_review_findings.finding: The committed render entry produces layout_diagnostics.json and media_validation.json, but does not produce the delivered clock_validation.json or renderer_capabilities.json. No generator for those two reports or new adapter tests was added in this commit.
code_review_findings.qualification: This does not establish that the delivered reports are false; it limits automatic regeneration of their evidence in later runs.

code_review_findings.finding: Large one-second camera magnification as measured above.

Enabling the photo restores an 18-to-120-candle pullback in 0.5 seconds, then a return to the 18-candle window after 126 seconds. The currently delivered photo-missing video does not contain that pullback.

not_measured_or_not_performed: Numerical derivatives or acceleration thresholds for camera C1; continuity is analytically supported for the current configuration, with positions checked independently.
